instruction: Find Portal 2 in the store and put all its DLC content in the cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Portal 2 in Steam store and adding DLC content to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete requirement coverage: Instruction requires adding 'all its DLC content' (plural, comprehensive), but expected value only checks for one specific DLC item 'Portal 2 - The Final Hours'
Portal 2 has multiple DLC items available on Steam, not just one. The evaluator will pass even if only one DLC is added to cart, failing to verify the 'all DLC content' requirement
Expected value is semantically incorrect: It does not represent the complete set of Portal 2 DLC content as required by the instruction
The metric logic (is_added_to_steam_cart) only verifies that items in the expected list are present, so with an incomplete expected list, it cannot properly verify task completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected.rules.items to include ALL Portal 2 DLC items available on Steam (e.g., ['Portal 2 - The Final Hours', 'Portal 2 Soundtrack', ...])
Alternatively, if only one specific DLC was intended, update the instruction to specify 'put Portal 2 - The Final Hours DLC in the cart' instead of 'all its DLC content'
Consider adding metadata about the actual count of Portal 2 DLC items to ensure the expected list is complete and accurate
